officialTitle: HERceptin Adjuvant (HERA) trial: trastuzumab after adjuvant chemotherapy in HER2-positive breast cancer

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: HERA (BIG 1-01) is an international, multicentre, open-label, phase 3 randomised trial of 5102 women with HER2-positive early breast cancer, who were enrolled from hospitals in 39 countries between Dec 7, 2001, and June 20, 2005.
design.notes: Three arms: observation, 1 year, or 2 years of trastuzumab after primary therapy. Comparison of 2 vs 1 year based on 366-day landmark analyses. Selective crossover from observation to trastuzumab occurred after the first results.

sponsor: F. Hoffmann-La Roche / Breast International Group
clinicalQuestion: Does trastuzumab given after completion of adjuvant chemotherapy improve outcomes in HER2-positive early breast cancer, and is 2 years better than 1 year?

pico.population: Women with HER2-positive early breast cancer who had completed locoregional therapy and at least four cycles of (neo)adjuvant chemotherapy
pico.intervention: Trastuzumab every 3 weeks for 1 year (or 2 years)
pico.outcomes: Primary: DFS. Secondary: OS, cardiac safety

arms.label: Trastuzumab 1 year
arms.dosing: 8 mg/kg loading dose IV, then 6 mg/kg every 3 weeks
arms.doseSourceQuote: patients were randomly assigned (1:1:1) to receive trastuzumab for 1 year (once at 8 mg/kg of bodyweight intravenously, then 6 mg/kg once every 3 weeks) or for 2 years (with the same dose schedule), or to the observation group.

arms.label: Trastuzumab 2 years
arms.dosing: 8 mg/kg loading dose IV, then 6 mg/kg every 3 weeks
arms.doseSourceQuote: patients were randomly assigned (1:1:1) to receive trastuzumab for 1 year (once at 8 mg/kg of bodyweight intravenously, then 6 mg/kg once every 3 weeks) or for 2 years (with the same dose schedule), or to the observation group.

publications.title: Trastuzumab after adjuvant chemotherapy in HER2-positive breast cancer.
publications.label: First planned interim analysis (1 year vs observation)

publications.title: 11 years' follow-up of trastuzumab after adjuvant chemotherapy in HER2-positive early breast cancer: final analysis of the HERceptin Adjuvant (HERA) trial.
publications.label: Final analysis at 11 years' median follow-up

outcomes.experimentalValue: Absolute DFS benefit at two years 8.4 percentage points
outcomes.sourceQuote: The unadjusted hazard ratio for an event in the trastuzumab group, as compared with the observation group, was 0.54 (95 percent confidence interval, 0.43 to 0.67; P<0.0001 by the log-rank test, crossing the interim analysis boundary), representing an absolute benefit in terms of disease-free survival at two years of 8.4 percentage points.

After a median follow-up of 11 years (IQR 10·09-11·53), random assignment to 1 year of trastuzumab significantly reduced the risk of a disease-free survival event (HR 0·76, 95% CI 0·68-0·86) and death (0·74, 0·64-0·86) compared with observation.

After a median follow-up of 11 years (IQR 10·09-11·53), random assignment to 1 year of trastuzumab significantly reduced the risk of a disease-free survival event (HR 0·76, 95% CI 0·68-0·86) and death (0·74, 0·64-0·86) compared with observation.
2 years of adjuvant trastuzumab did not improve disease free-survival outcomes compared with 1 year of this drug (HR 1·02, 95% CI 0·89-1·17).
Estimates of 10-year disease-free survival were 63% for observation, 69% for 1 year of trastuzumab, and 69% for 2 years of trastuzumab.

safety.sourceQuote: Severe cardiotoxicity developed in 0.5 percent of the women who were treated with trastuzumab.

safety.description: Secondary cardiac endpoints (experimental = 1 year trastuzumab; 2 years: 7.3%)
safety.sourceQuote: The incidence of secondary cardiac endpoints was 122 (7·3%) in the 2-years trastuzumab group, 74 (4·4%) in the 1-year trastuzumab group, and 15 (0·9%) in the observation group.

strengths: Large international randomised trial with 11-year follow-up
Addresses both efficacy and duration of adjuvant trastuzumab
limitations: Substantial selective crossover from observation to trastuzumab dilutes long-term comparisons

clinicalImplications.text: Established 1 year of adjuvant trastuzumab as standard for HER2-positive early breast cancer; 2 years added no disease-free survival benefit and more cardiac events.

tumourBoardPearl.text: One year is the reference duration — HERA showed no gain from doubling it, only more cardiac toxicity.

curation.notes: Numbers transcribed from PubMed abstracts of PMIDs 16236737 and 28215665. Arm sizes are from the 11-year ITT population (PMID 28215665).
